dossiers_buy.risks: Macro downturn suppresses attendance and pay-per-view. Talent/athlete cost inflation. PE=65.6 with ROIC=6% offers no floor. Media rights renewal below expectations.
dossiers_buy.bear_case: Macro downturn suppresses live events; talent costs inflate; media rights disappoint; PE=65.6 de-rates on earnings miss.
dossiers_buy.what_would_change_our_mind: ROIC fails to improve above 12% by 2027 OR media rights renewal below inflation escalator.
dossiers_buy.entry_trigger: No entry at ROIC=6%. Watch for ROIC trend above 12% on two quarters of operating leverage evidence.
